PDF table-chrome headers ('Main Notes', 'Sl.No. Notes Notification Date Notification No', 'Export Licensing Notes', 'Product Description and Export Policy', 'Itc(hs) Code. Description Export Policy Policy Condition') were recognized as table chrome and EXCLUDED from the legal notes per extraction rules.

Section VI 'Main Notes' (4 notes) are attributed to section_notes (Section VI, Products of the Chemical or Allied Industries), not chapter_notes — consistent with Ch.28-38 governance under Section VI.
Chapter 32 chapter_notes contain 6 entries (Notes 1-6) covering exclusions, definitions of stamping foils and colouring matter, scope of headings 3203-3208.

Heading 3204 contains numerous subheadings with deep sub-classifications: 3204.11 (Disperse dyes), 3204.12 (Acid/mordant dyes), 3204.13 (Basic dyes), 3204.14 (Direct dyes), 3204.15 (Vat dyes), 3204.16 (Reactive dyes), 3204.17 (Pigments), 3204.18 (Carotenoid), 3204.19 (Other). Many sub-items split by colour with '----' prefix indicators preserved verbatim.

Subheading 3204.11 PDF description renders as 'Synthetic organic colouring matter and preparations based thereon as specified in Note 3 to this Chapter : -- Disperse dyes and preparations based thereon' — preserved verbatim including the WCO HS '-- ' double-hyphen subheading indicators.

Subheading 3204.14 in PDF lists tariff lines 3204.14.11 and 3204.14.19 with description 'Other non-azo basic dyes: ---- Yellow 12 (Chrysophenine G)' and 'Other non-azo basic dyes: ---- Other'. This appears to be an OCR/labelling artifact — the subheading title is '-- Direct dyes and preparations based thereon' but the tariff line description column still references the prior subheading's 'Other non-azo basic dyes:' prefix. Preserved verbatim as in source PDF.

Heading 3204 subheading 3204.19 includes deep sub-classifications for Azoic Coupling Components, Azoic Diazo Components, Azoic colours, Sulphur-based, Solvent-based and Food colouring matters — each split into colours (Yellows, Oranges, Reds, etc.). Each tariff line description begins with the parent sub-group label followed by ': ---- ' and the specific item, preserved verbatim.

Tariff line 3203.00.90 ('Other') has an Export Policy of 'Free' but the Policy Condition column contains an extended note describing Restricted Export Authorisation for Dye made from Red Sanders wood (CITES, MEP, quantity ceilings). Captured in policy_conditions.
Export Licensing Notes section contains 1 entry: Value added products of Red Sanders wood require Restricted Export Authorisation and CITES documentation.
Heading 3214 PDF description renders 'non-refractory surfacing preparations for faades' (typo for 'facades') — preserved verbatim.
Tariff line 3204.11.59 description renders as 'Disperse Blue: ---- Other' — colour-grouping prefix is consistent across the Disperse Blue range (3204.11.51-3204.11.59).

Heading 3206 description in PDF reads 'Other colouring matter; preparations as specified in Note 3 to this Chapter, other than those of heading 32.03, 32.04 or 32.05; inorganic products of a kind used as luminophores, whether or not chemically defined' — preserved verbatim including the dot-separated heading references.

Subheading 3206.41 tariff line 3206.41.00 is listed in the PDF as '32064100' without an explicit subheading parent code '320641'. Inferred subheading 3206.41 from the 8-digit code structure. Same applies to 3206.42 (32064200), 3206.50 (32065000), 3204.18 (32041800), 3204.20 series, etc.

Subheading 3208.90 is split across pages: tariff lines 3208.90.11, 3208.90.19, 3208.90.21, 3208.90.22, 3208.90.29, 3208.90.30, 3208.90.41, 3208.90.49, 3208.90.50, 3208.90.90. Preserved verbatim with their colour/category sub-group prefixes (Enamels, Varnishes).
Heading 3211 ('Prepared driers') has a single 8-digit code 3211.00.00 — no intermediate subheading shown in source. Normalized to subheading 3211.00 → tariff line 3211.00.00.

The 'Export Policy' and 'Policy Condition' columns are not part of the tariff line description field; they are captured separately. Unit-of-measure column (kg/u/etc) is NOT shown in this chapter's PDF — unit field set to null for all tariff lines.

chapter_notes.text: This Chapter does not cover : (a) separate chemically defined elements or compounds [except those of heading 3203 or 3204, inorganic products of a kind used as lumino-phores (heading 3206), glass obtained from fused quartz or other fused silica in the forms provided for in heading 3207, and also dyes and other colouring matter put up in forms or packings for retail sale, of heading 3212]; (b) tannates or other tannin derivatives of products of headings 2936 to 2939, 2941 or 3501 to 3504; or (c) mastics of asphalt or other bituminous mastics (heading 2715).
Heading 3204 includes mixtures of stabilised diazonium salts and couplersfor the production of azo dyes.

Headings 3203, 3204, 3205 and 3206 apply also to preparations based on colouringmatter(including, in the case of heading 3206, colouring pigments of heading 2530 or Chapter 28, metal flakes and metal powders), of a kind used for colouring any material or used as ingredients in the manufacture of colouring preparations. The headings do not apply, however, to pigments dispersed in non-aqueous media, in liquid or paste form, of a kind used in the manufacture of paints, including enamels (heading 3212), or to other preparations of heading 3207, 3208, 3209, 3210, 3212 or 3215.

Heading 3208 includes solutions (other than collodions) consisting of any of the products specified in headings 3901 to 3913 in volatile organic solvents when the weight of the solvent exceeds 50 per cent. of the weight of the solution.
The expression "colouring matter" in this Chapter does not include products of a kind used as extenders in oil paints, whether or not they are also suitable for colouring distempers.

The expression ""stamping foils"" in heading 3212 applies only to thin sheets of a kind used for printing, for example, book covers or hat bands, and consisting of : (a) metallic powder (including powder of precious metal) or pigment, agglomerated with glue, gelatin or other binder; or (b) metal (including precious metal) or pigment, deposited on a supporting sheet of any material.

section_notes.text: (A) Goods (other than radioactive ores) answering to a description in heading 2844 or 2845 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule. (B) Subject to paragraph (A) above, goods answering to a description in heading 2843, 2846 or 2852 are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Section.

Subject to Note 1 above, goods classifiable in heading 3004, 3005, 3006, 3212, 3303, 3304, 3305, 3306, 3307, 3506, 3707 or 3808 by reason of being put up in measured doses or for retail sale are to be classified in those headings and in no other heading of this Schedule.

Goods put up in sets consisting of two or more separate constituents,some or all of which fall in this Section and are intended to be mixed together to obtain a product of Section VI or VII, are to be classified in the heading appropriate to that product, provided that the constituents are: (a) having regard to the manner in which they are put up, clearly identifiable as being intended to be used together without first being repacked; (b) presented together; and (c) identifiable, whether by their nature or by the relative proportions in which they are present, as being complementary one to another.

Where a product answers to a description in one or more of the headings in Section VI by virtue of being described by name or function and also to heading 3827, then it is classifiable in a heading that references the product by name or function and not under heading 3827.

tariff_lines.policy_condition: However, exoport of Dye made from Red Sanders wood are Restricted wherein Exports is permitted under Restricted Export Authorisation subject to the following documentation: Applications for Restricted Export Authorisation should be accompanied by attested copies of certificate of origin issued by the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests of the State from where the stocks were procured, giving details of the date of procurement from legal sources and quantities procured. A Certificate of the current position of stocks so procured and available with the applicant given after physical verification of the stocks, by the authority nominated for the purpose by the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests, should also accompany application for export authorisation. The applications shall be considered on merits for issuance of Restricted Export Authorisation, which shall be subject to any other conditions such as MEP, quantity ceilings requirements under CITES, etc. as may be prescribed from time to time.
